lines.t: A whisper breaks the silence, calling through the noise
A fire in the distance, a still and urgent voice
You walked among the shadows, calling it the light
Drinking from the broken well that never satisfied
You heard but never listened, you saw but remained blind
Chasing every fleeting thing while truth was left behind
Now the veil is tearing open
Now the sound is clear
Every word like thunder
Ringing in your ears
Come out, come out from the illusion
Turn your heart, don't delay The voice is calling from the heavens
I am the truth, the life, the way Break off every chain that held you
Let the old self fade away There is mercy in the morning
There is life if you obey
You built your own foundation on the sand of your desire
Every tower made of pride now trembles in the fire
You traded truth for comfort, you silenced what was real
But the world still stands unshaken and reveals what you conceal
Now the time is drawing nearer
No more standing still
Every heart will answer
Every soul will kneel
Come out, come out from the illusion
Turn your heart, don't delay
The voice is calling from the heavens
I am the truth, the life, the way
Break off every chain that held you
Let the old self fade away
There is mercy in the warnings
There is life if you obey
Not in the noise of many voices
Not in the pride of man
But in the quiet burning presence
Where it all began
He's calling you to surrender
To leave it all behind
To walk into the living light
And see with open eyes
Hear it
Feel it
The call is alive
Come out, come out from the illusion
This is your awakening
The door is open, step into it
Leave behind everything
No more chase, no more hiding
Step into the flame
There is mercy in his calling
There is power in his name
The voice is still calling
Will you turn or walk away?
We'll be right back.
